reportedIssues: The promotional badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '-100%', implying the entire order is free. This is almost certainly a data/formatting error (e.g. a discount fraction rendered as a percentage) rather than a real offer.

The favorite (heart) button on the second card uses a dark, near-black circular background with a dark outline icon, placed over a dark image area, making it barely visible. The equivalent button on the Tokumaru Ramen card above uses a white circle with a dark icon.
The heart icon buttons have no visible text label; combined with the low-contrast variant, their tappable state (favorited vs not) is ambiguous.

The first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké) has a very light, nearly white image background while its sibling cards use dark imagery, making the row look visually inconsistent and the card edges hard to perceive.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 directly describes the discount badge showing −100% on a Popular right now card, matching the expected defect exactly.
